questions.stem:
Jessica prepares \(x\) g of sauce A and \(y\) g of sauce B using 110 g of vinegar, 180 g of salad cream and 300 g of ketchup. Sauce A uses vinegar, salad cream and ketchup in the ratio \(1:2:2\); sauce B uses them in the ratio \(1:1:3\).
(a) Write all constraints on \(x,y\).
(b) Represent the feasible region graphically.
(c) A 100 g bottle of sauce A earns $40 and a 100 g bottle of sauce B earns $30. Find the maximum profit.
questions.stemZh:
Jessica 用 110 g 醋、180 g 沙律醬及 300 g 茄汁製作 x g 醬汁 A 和 y g 醬汁 B。醬汁 A 中醋、沙律醬及茄汁的比例為 \(1:2:2\)；醬汁 B 的比例為 \(1:1:3\)。
(a) 列出 x、y 的所有限制。
(b) 在坐標平面上表示可行區域。
(c) 每瓶 100 g 醬汁 A 和醬汁 B 的利潤分別為 $40 和 $30。求最大利潤。
questions.hint: Convert each ingredient ratio into a per-gram usage, then compare profit at every feasible vertex.
questions.hintZh: 先把配方比例轉成每克用量，再於每個可行頂點比較利潤。
questions.answer: (a) x+y≤550, 2x+y≤900, 2x+3y≤1500, x≥0, y≥0. (c) $190 for whole 100 g bottles. The continuous-by-gram model gives $200.
questions.solution:
(a) Each sauce has total ratio 5. The vinegar limit gives \((x+y)/5\leq110\), hence \(x+y\leq550\). Salad cream gives \((2x+y)/5\leq180\), hence \(2x+y\leq900\). Ketchup gives \((2x+3y)/5\leq300\), hence \(2x+3y\leq1500\), with \(x,y\geq0\).
(b) The feasible vertices are \((0,0)\), \((450,0)\), \((350,200)\), \((150,400)\) and \((0,500)\).
(c) For whole 100 g bottles, let \(a=x/100\) and \(b=y/100\) be nonnegative integers. Then \(a+b\leq5.5\), \(2a+b\leq9\) and \(2a+3b\leq15\). For a=0,1,2,3,4, the greatest possible b is 5,4,3,2,1; the corresponding profits \(40a+30b\) are $150,$160,$170,$180,$190. The maximum is $190 from 4 bottles of A and 1 bottle of B (400 g and 100 g), matching the source key. If partial bottles/by-gram sales are permitted instead, the continuous model reaches $200 at (350,200). Thus the printed answer requires the whole-bottle interpretation.

questions.stem: In Figure 12, \(L_1:2x+5y=10\) and \(L_2:7x+4y=28\). (a) Write down the system whose solution is the region (including the boundary) bounded by \(L_1,L_2\) and the y-axis. (b) Find the maximum of \(P=x-2y+1\) and the corresponding \(x,y\), when \((x,y)\) is one of the dots in Figure 12.
questions.stemZh: 圖 12 中，\(L_1:2x+5y=10\)，\(L_2:7x+4y=28\)。(a) 寫出解集為 \(L_1,L_2\) 及 y 軸所圍區域（包括邊界）的不等式組。(b) 若 \((x,y)\) 為圖 12 的其中一個黑點，求 \(P=x-2y+1\) 的最大值及相應的 \(x,y\)。
questions.solution: (a) The region is right of the y-axis, above \(L_1\) and below \(L_2\), hence \(x\ge0,2x+5y\ge10,7x+4y\le28\). (b) Read every displayed dot, not the continuous intersection. For x=0,1,2 the smallest displayed y is 2, yielding respective row maxima -3,-2,-1. The remaining dot \((3,1)\) gives \(P=3-2+1=2\), the maximum.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 區域在 y 軸右方、\(L_1\) 上方及 \(L_2\) 下方，故 \(x\ge0,2x+5y\ge10,7x+4y\le28\)。(b) 必須比較圖中黑點，而不是連續區域交點。x=0、1、2 各列最低黑點均為 y=2，該列最大目標值依次為 −3、−2、−1。餘下黑點 \((3,1)\) 給 \(P=3-2+1=2\)，為最大值。

questions.stem: (a) In the figure, the x-intercept of \(L_1\) is 24 and \(L_1\) passes through \(A(4,10)\). Also \(L_2:2x+y=30\). Find the system whose solution is the shaded region (including the boundary). (b) A party room charges $400 per child and $800 per adult for a three-hour session. Booking the entire venue costs at least $9600. Each child gets 6 game coins and each adult 3; at most 90 coins are provided. Afterwards each child gets 3 presents and each adult 1. On a day, x children and y adults book the entire venue. Someone claims the maximum number of presents is more than 40. Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh: (a) 圖中 \(L_1\) 的 x 截距為 24，且通過 \(A(4,10)\)；\(L_2:2x+y=30\)。求解集為陰影區域（包括邊界）的不等式組。(b) 派對房間每節三小時，每名兒童收費 $400、成人 $800；包場最低收費 $9600。每名兒童獲 6 枚遊戲幣，成人獲 3 枚，每節最多提供 90 枚。活動後每名兒童獲 3 份禮物，成人獲 1 份。某日 x 名兒童及 y 名成人包場。有人聲稱禮物總數的最大值多於 40，你是否同意？解釋答案。
questions.solution: (a) The slope of \(L_1\) is \((10-0)/(4-24)=-1/2\), giving \(x+2y=24\). The shade gives \(x\ge0,x+2y\ge24,2x+y\le30\). (b) The constraints are \(400x+800y\ge9600\), \(6x+3y\le90\), with non-negative integers x,y. Equivalently \(x+2y\ge24,2x+y\le30\). The continuous vertices \((0,12),(0,30),(12,6)\) give \(3x+y=12,30,42\). The maximum 42 is attained at the integer pair (12,6), so it is also the integer optimum. Since 42>40, agree.

questions.stem: (a) In Figure 4 shade the solution of \[\begin{cases}x\ge1\\y\ge0\\2x+3y<16\\x-2y\le2\end{cases}\](b) Let R be this solution region. Five different points are randomly chosen from all integer-coordinate points in R. Find the probability that (i) exactly three chosen points have x-coordinate 2; (ii) at least three chosen points have x-coordinate 2.
questions.stemZh: (a) 在圖 4 塗上以下不等式組的解集區域：\[\begin{cases}x\ge1\\y\ge0\\2x+3y<16\\x-2y\le2\end{cases}\](b) 設 R 為上述區域。從 R 內所有整數坐標點中隨機選取五個不同的點。求以下概率：(i) 恰有三個點的 x 坐標為 2；(ii) 至少三個點的 x 坐標為 2。
questions.solution: (a) Shade right of x=1, above y=0 and y=(x-2)/2, and strictly below 2x+3y=16. The last line is dashed. (b) For x=1,2,3,4 there are respectively 5,4,3,2 integer points, 14 in total; no larger integer x is feasible. Exactly 4 points have x=2 and 10 do not. (i) \(\binom43\binom{10}2/\binom{14}5=90/1001\). (ii) Add the four-point case: \((\binom43\binom{10}2+\binom44\binom{10}1)/\binom{14}5=95/1001\). Sampling is without replacement because the five points are different.

questions.stem: The figure shows a region bounded by the x-axis, y-axis, \(L_1\) and \(L_2\). \(L_1\) passes through \(A(0,6),B(2,5)\), and \(L_2:5x+4y=30\). (a) Find the system represented by the shaded region, including the boundary. (b) Let \(P=ax+y\), where a is an integer greater than 1. Find the point in the region at which P attains its maximum.
questions.stemZh: 圖中區域由 x 軸、y 軸、\(L_1\) 及 \(L_2\) 圍成。\(L_1\) 通過 \(A(0,6),B(2,5)\)，且 \(L_2:5x+4y=30\)。(a) 求陰影區域（包括邊界）所表示的不等式組。(b) 設 \(P=ax+y\)，其中 a 為大於 1 的整數，求 P 取得最大值的點。
questions.solution: (a) The slope of L1 is -1/2, hence \(x+2y=12\). The region satisfies \(x\ge0,y\ge0,x+2y\le12,5x+4y\le30\). (b) At vertices \((0,0),(0,6),(2,5),(6,0)\), P is \(0,6,2a+5,6a\). Since a is an integer greater than 1, \(a\ge2\). Then \(6a>6\) and \(6a-(2a+5)=4a-5\ge3>0\). Thus the unique maximiser is (6,0).
questions.hint: Find every feasible vertex, then compare the objective values.
questions.hintZh: 求出所有可行頂點，再比較目標函數值。

questions.stem: A man has $800 to buy stocks A and B. Each share of A costs $20 and earns $1.8 in one year; each share of B costs $10 and earns $0.8. For every share of A, at least two shares of B must be bought. Share counts are integers. Let x,y be the numbers of A,B shares. (a) Write all constraints. (b) Indicate all solutions on the coordinate grid. (c) How many shares of each should he buy to maximise one-year profit?
questions.stemZh: 某人有 $800 購買股票 A、B。每股 A 價 $20，一年盈利 $1.8；每股 B 價 $10，一年盈利 $0.8。每購買一股 A，須至少購買兩股 B，股數必須為整數。設 x、y 分別為 A、B 的股數。(a) 寫出全部限制。(b) 在坐標格上標示全部可行解。(c) 為使一年盈利最大，應各買多少股？
questions.answer: (a) \(20x+10y\le800,y\ge2x,x,y\in\mathbb Z_{\ge0}\). (c) 20 A shares, 40 B shares; profit $68.
questions.solution: (a) \(20x+10y\le800,y\ge2x\), and x,y are non-negative integers. (b) Plot the integer points in \(x\ge0,y\ge0,2x+y\le80,y\ge2x\), not every point of the continuous shaded triangle. (c) \(P=1.8x+0.8y\). The continuous vertices (0,0),(0,80),(20,40) give profits $0,$64,$68. The continuous maximiser (20,40) has integer coordinates, so it is feasible for the original problem and is also the integer maximum. Buy 20 A shares and 40 B shares, spending all $800; profit $68.
questions.solutionZh: (a) \(20x+10y\le800,y\ge2x\)，且 x、y 為非負整數。(b) 在 \(x\ge0,y\ge0,2x+y\le80,y\ge2x\) 內標示整數格點，不能把整個連續陰影三角形都視作可買股數。(c) \(P=1.8x+0.8y\)。連續區域頂點 (0,0)、(0,80)、(20,40) 的盈利為 $0、$64、$68。連續最大點 (20,40) 本身為整數點，因此亦是原題的整數最大點。購 A 20 股、B 40 股，花費 $800，一年盈利 $68。
questions.hint: Keep the integer domain and every strict boundary when counting feasible points.
questions.hintZh: 計數可行點時，保留整數限制及所有嚴格邊界。
